title: Best Laptop Deals (Black Friday 2026)
summary: 5 laptops worth buying on sale this Black Friday, with the October 2026 prices to beat.
method: Black Friday 2026 is Friday, November 27, and Cyber Monday is November 30, with many early sales already live. Picks come from current October 2026 deal roundups (TechRadar, GamesRadar, Memeburn) and 2026 buying guides, chosen to cover five different buyers: Mac, cheap Mac, budget Windows, 2-in-1 and gaming. Prices shown are the October 2026 deal prices as reported, at the retailer named. They change often and the retailer may not be Amazon, so treat each as a price to beat, not a promise. The Amazon buttons search for the model, so compare before you buy. A bigger advertised discount does not always mean a better deal. Compare against the lowest recent price, not the crossed-out one.
assumptions: no prices are guaranteed to be available on Black Friday itself. We will update this guide as real Black Friday deals go live.

products.name: Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M5)
specs: Rated best overall laptop in several 2026 buying guides
pros: Top pick for students, office workers, programmers and travelers
Listed by Memeburn as the best MacBook to watch for Black Friday
cons: Costs noticeably more than the MacBook Neo
Apple discounts are usually modest, so wait only if a small saving is enough
products.best_for: Anyone who wants one laptop that does everything and lasts for years.

products.name: Apple MacBook Neo
specs: Named best value Mac in a 2026 buying guide
pros: Already discounted at Apple in October
cons: Entry-level Mac, so compare specs with the MacBook Air before buying
A deal at Apple may not be matched at Amazon
products.best_for: Students and first-time Mac buyers on a tight budget.

products.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3x

Confirm RAM and storage on the exact listing
